laws.title: Wahlgesetz des Landes Sachsen-Anhalt (LWG)
laws.citation: LWG in der Fassung der Bekanntmachung vom 18. Februar 2010 (GVBl. LSA S. 80), zuletzt geändert durch Artikel 2 des Gesetzes vom 19. März 2021 (GVBl. LSA S. 98); Sec. 1, 32, 33, 35 unchanged in substance up to the Gesetz vom 7. Februar 2025 (GVBl. LSA S. 316)

steps.title: The chamber has seats seats to begin with, e.g

children.title: Sum the valid votes of section, grouped by the units of level and by option or party
Sum the valid votes of section, grouped by the units of level and by option or party
One mandate per unit
Apply threshold to the parties (or, to="option", the options) of a vote

arguments: votes per party, summed over the units

children.title: The seats the proportional allocation divides

arguments: mandates of no party or of a party not eligible

children.title: Apportion seats_to_apportion by method among the columns of the table it takes, <section> by <level> × <by> (zweitstimme by land × eligible party), on their votes there
Deduct each eligible party's Wahlkreis seats from its entitlement

steps.title: Set caucus_size from all valid votes

arguments: the votes counted and the fictitious party's

steps.title: While the allocation leaves overhang to balance, run protocol again
steps.condition: while overhang > 0; after 2 rounds, while 2 × overhang > caucus_size

laws.title: Gesetz über die Wahlen im Land Mecklenburg-Vorpommern (Landes- und Kommunalwahlgesetz - LKWG M-V)
laws.citation: LKWG M-V vom 16. Dezember 2010 (GVOBl. M-V S. 690), Fassung gültig vom 1. September 2026 bis 31. Dezember 2028, zuletzt geändert durch Artikel 12 des Gesetzes vom 8. Juli 2026 (GVOBl. M-V S. 719, 731); Sec. 54, 57, 58 unchanged since 1 January 2011

steps.title: The chamber has seats seats to begin with, e.g

children.title: Sum the valid votes of section, grouped by the units of level and by option or party
Sum the valid votes of section, grouped by the units of level and by option or party
One mandate per unit
Apply threshold to the parties (or, to="option", the options) of a vote

arguments: votes per party, summed over the units

steps.title: Allocate the seats of the chamber size with protocol; then, while a party holds Überhang (overhang), raise the chamber_size one seat at a time and allocate again, until every party's entitlement covers its Wahlkreis seats

children.title: Several steps as one
The seats the proportional allocation divides

arguments: mandates of no party or of a party not eligible

children.title: Apportion seats_to_apportion by method among the columns of the table it takes, <section> by <level> × <by> (zweitstimme by land × eligible party), on their votes there
Deduct each eligible party's Wahlkreis seats from its entitlement
